parallel_worker_fusion.non_additivity_rule: Do not add 31 cognitive-organ lineage IDs and 34 technical service/process lineage IDs to claim 65/74 historical module-file coverage; the namespaces may overlap and are not proven to partition the 74 services/ files.

feedback.frank: One-process/one-UnifiedDB final-target sandbox now has executable integration evidence for named organs, re-entry, effects, restart and recovered technical lineages; do not claim whole-74 coverage yet.
feedback.unifieddb: The same authoritative SQLite successfully carried cognition, lineage, snapshots, bridges and recovery probes; keep provenance namespaces explicit rather than flattening them.
feedback.claygraph: Final-target sandbox can dissolve the separate runtime graph DB while retaining transient associative topology and lineage; treat this as sandbox evidence, not a universal proof that a separate graph store is never useful.
feedback.gwt: Require receiver/use/outcome/re-entry receipts; invocation alone is insufficient.
feedback.emergenz: Goal candidates are transient coalitions in the sandbox, not a durable goal-list; next evidence should use lesion/rescue and matched ablations rather than a single emergence scalar.
feedback.claycode: Port the passing behavioral contract into the compiled final-binary path without reintroducing service/DB fragmentation.
feedback.harness: Adopt the three-receipt stack: integrated contract, stress/recovery, recovered-lineage fusion; next add exact inventory and causal lesion/rescue coverage.
feedback.security: Preserve current-main F6 endpoint hardening and fail-closed external effects during integration.
feedback.model-runtime: Use the hardened engine-neutral loopback boundary for a real Qwen-class 4B sandbox receipt; do not make the serving engine identity/persistence authority.
feedback.memory: Restart, snapshot and committed-WAL recovery pass; arbitrary power-loss/filesystem fault injection remains open.
